note: Structural, model-independent cap on base-self ordering (no critic scores). true_best_added = source where the true-best measured candidate was NOT emitted by the base generator, so base-self can never rank it top-1. base_reachable% = % sources where true-best measured IS in the generated 32-pool (the ceiling for base-self conditional_rank_acc@1, even with perfect base ordering). Critic can score measured-added seqs, so only it can reach these sources.
caveat: critic conditional_rank_acc and measured_best_avg_rank still require the V5-critic BF16 GPU run (all GPUs busy; CPU fallback impossible - frozen critic is CUDA-only). See A3_critic_mixed_pool_probe.py (dry-stub validated) + A3_critic_mixed_pool_probe.md.
